contexts.text: This would be to have an infernal deep between him and the Lord.
Deep of lip () is said of the gentiles, who, although they are in falsity of doctrine, are still in charity...
The more the Hells will to lift up their heads to Heaven, the more deeply they depress themselves.
By phantasies Spirits may be carried up on high... and at the same moment into the deep.
In the other life, all who are in self-love are more deeply infernal than others.
The Hell of the most deceitful is deeply under the heel.
The deepest Hell awaits (profaners).

They who are in self-love, being against all good whatever, are in the deepest and therefore in the most grievous Hells; but they who are in the love of the world... are in Hells not so deep... AC 8318:3.
Magicians... are deeply in caverns; those who have been more pernicious are more deeply buried.
Beneath the heel... there is a Hell deep down... Here are the most wicked... They are often punished, and are then let more deeply down... Out of that deep is sometimes heard a tumult as of massacre.
The more deeply (they cast themselves into Hell) the better it is for them.
These Hells are... partly deep down in front.
There appeared a great square opening tending obliquely downwards to a great depth; in the deep was seen a round opening...
Such are cast into Hell deeply.
Genii are in the Hells at the back, deep down...
They were seen rising from the deep...
They are more tortured by the evil of their life in Heaven than in the deepest Hell.
When the infernals try to attack goods, they are cast deeply into Hell.
In the deepest (of the Hells of the magicians) are the Egyptians.
Whenever (the Hells endeavour to force their way up) a number of them are cast down more deeply.
Abysses mean abundance of water in the deeps... and by the deeps are signified the Hells.
They went down into the depths like a stone () = they sank to lower things as by their weight... The depths = lower things where the Hells are.
Under Deep, see this reference.
(The term deep is illustrated.)
The reason the deep = Hell relatively to evil, is that it is opposite to high, by which is signified Heaven, and which is predicated of good.
They sought the deep like lead () = that evil dragged them down to lower things, like weights in the world. The deep = lower things, and the Hells as to evils.
They who are in the evil of self-love are deeply in Hell in proportion to the quality and quantity of that love.
States of truth and good, and, in the opposite sense, states of falsity and evil, are represented in the other life by heights and depths.
Hence deep things = exterior ones, and high things = interior ones.
The depth of the sea () = Hell.
Hell is said to be in the deep, because there are no perfection, intelligence or wisdom, and no good and truth there.
The Hells of the profanations of truth... are deeper than the Hells of all other evils, and are rarely opened.
They who have denied the Lord's Divine... are let down into the deep, and thus completely separated from the rest from the Christian world.
They who are not so deceitful... are not in such deep Hells.
In the deeper Hells are those who have acted interiorly from evil; in the less deep ones are those who have acted exteriorly, that is, from the falsities of evil.
Of himself, an evil man continually leads himself more deeply into his evils. Explained.

Who have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak () = who do not understand their interior things, which are mere falsities... Its depths = the interior things of the doctrine separated from charity... The deep and interior things of this doctrine are what are delivered in their books, lectures, and preaching.
Their lot is that they are let down into the deep...
Have you seen Socinus... or Arius?... They are in the deep beneath you...
Without the understanding of the Word, as it is in itself, in its bosom, and in its depth...
On the deepest Hell. SE 1278. SE 1279. SE 1288, General article. SE 3358.
On a deep Hell under the feet.
They were let down to some depth.
Being inspected when in the deep...

In all the Hells there are places deeper and deeper, which are worse in the lower parts, and still worse in the still deeper ones; I have seen them cast down from one depth into another; and the deeper they go the denser is the appearance of the mist which encompasses them...
The depth (of this Hell) is great.
There are gulfs wide and long, and also deep... with depths doubled and trebled.
The depths (of their Hell) are numerous according to the degree of the evil.

Who have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak = ensnarement thereby... Satan... continually inspires the loves of self and of the world, and man receives these loves with delight, because they are in him hereditarily, and thus are his proprium; thus does Hell insinuate itself with man and ensnare him; these things are what are signified by the depths of Satan.
A people of depths of lip () = falsities of doctrine confirmed even to the appearance of truth. AE 455:13.
Peoples deep of lip () = those who are in doctrine which is not intelligible.
Wonders in the deep () = the hidden things of intelligence and wisdom.

The depths of the waters () = falsities from the Hells; neither let the deep swallow me up = let not the Hell do so where are the falsities of evil, or let not the falsities of evil which are from Hell.
This is signified by... He dried up the sea... and set its depths for a way that the redeemed might pass over ().
To dry up all the depths of the river () = to dissipate all the falsities of evil, even the deeper ones.
The depths of the sea () = the Hells where and whence are the falsities of evil; therefore it is said that He will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.
Into the depth even into the heart of the seas () = Hell.
The sea and its depths = the Hells. Illustrated.
In the depths () = as it were in evils.
To be sunk in the deep of the sea () = to be cast into Hell.
